scope: Only bounded reads and diagnostic file output; no visibility setters, activation changes, tick release, lazy getters, extra native game calls or lifetime extension

sampling.seed: source and owned snapshots before native Move and after existing post-pose guards
sampling.cleanup: once immediately before first actual ActorDestroy call; not after retired identity
requested_origin: pose_argument: exact worldXYZ passed to existing Move call
model_at_cleanup: fresh reconstruction of primary model worldXYZ, not a new Move call

confirmed_fields.note: Root UObject identity, Scene class and owner rechecked
Only bytes0x220..0x237 decoded as XYZ; rotation/scale not interpreted
Covers every byte188..190 inclusive; not a three-byte shorthand
No guessed mesh asset offsets read

scene_type_gate.method: Read cached class, class hierarchy index at+38 and chain at+30; no getter invocation

components.required: Scene class proof, UObject index/pointer/header stability, owner90 matches owned actor, bounded allocation bitmap, stable set header
components.asset_fields: not read: skinned-specific class contract not included

metrics.actual_step: owned_after rootXYZ minus owned_before rootXYZ; same root identity required
metrics.invalid: valid:false, xyz:null, distance:null; no NaN or Infinity in JSON

failure_policy: Optional best-effort diagnostic operations return no permission to the flight ledger. Missing reads/files or C++ exceptions increment observation_failures and do not skip existing cleanup or change15s cap. observation_failures counts failed diagnostic operations, not distinct samples.
identity_note: Root and component serial0 is retained as an identity snapshot, not a newly allocated weak identity; no AllocateSerialNumber occurs in telemetry
